Heartlands currency. Instantly restores Vitality. Higher tier than regular Crystal Cubes.
Perception of spatial dimensions. Zane gained insight from surviving a voidstorm. Extremely rare — even Kenneth and Eddy have never learned them.
Fallen ancient sect whose ruins and treasures are hidden within the Cloud Road. Created the Drake puppet, Soulforge, and Crystal Key. Associated with the Blood Fiend Emperor.

Dark creatures found in confined worlds like the Death Road. Hunt anything alive, drawn by Vitality. Tar-like substance drains and consumes victims. Destroyed by heavenly thunder (Finn) or absorbed by Corrupt Vitality (Zane). Leave Soul Essence upon death.
Ritual pursued by the massive face entity threatening Elara. Requires target to reach Inner-Core Realm before execution. New plot element introduced Ep 351.
Above Inner-Core Realm. Major sect leaders operate at this level. Tia, Lady Darkmere, Raven, Kieran, Hobbes, Burns, Maddox.
Body Refining realm. Referenced once. Harder to achieve than Inner-Core or Spirit-Tribulation.
Zane's soul level. Makes him immune to soul attacks like Skull Ghost Hand. Achieved in upper world.
Above Divine Arms. Extremely rare. Known examples: Nameless Saber (Maddox), Soul Flag (ESS), Time Copper Coin (WMG), Heavenly Feather Crown, Dragonfall Palace Armor.
Fundamental energy in Zane's body. Used for Body Refining. Distinct from Vitality. Previously mistaken for purging energy.
Nine fundamental forces: Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, Electricity, plus two unnamed. Divided into ten layers each.
108 points in the human body. 20 in Crown Conduit. Refined using Law Power (flame + lightning). Zane refined all 108.
Monster from the River of the Netherworld. Summoned by the Nameless Saber. Born from Hell. Horns and saber-sharp tail.
Highest talent tier. Above saint-level. Eden Caldwell and Brent both possess it. Historically: six in Union of Seven Divine Kingdoms.
Base talent tier for top disciples of fourth-grade sects.
Above human. Common among sect elites.
High tier. Benson's level. Sects scramble to recruit.
Very rare. One every few decades. Brent's confirmed level. Ethereal Spirit Sect has ~10.
Rarest. Eden Caldwell. Historically six total across Seven Divine Kingdoms.
